# Play Effect

Source: [9268](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/9268); edited 2026-07-10. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Play Effect](../../api/actions/play-effect.md).

<a id="wiki-9268-n1"></a>

- Play Effect effects are short-lived and require no updates or destruction; they do not count against Create Effect's 128 limit.

<a id="wiki-9268-n2"></a>

- Custom Color is not supported; team colors depend on viewer hostility; player-valued position is sampled at playback.

Source limitations:

- Article's 'as many ... as you want' is a capacity claim for this action, not proof of unlimited performance or no other engine limits.
